data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Khamis is rooted in the Islamic belief that Thursday is a day when Allah's blessings are multiplied. According to hadith, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "There are five days on which Allah's blessings are multiplied: the first day of Rajab and the last day of Rajab, the Day of Arafah, the Day of Sacrifice, and Thursday." So, the name Khamis, being associated with the day of the week that holds such significance, is a reminder of the multiplied blessings that come with it, and a call to seek closer proximity to Allah on this day.
